# LinkFYR

> Free, open (Apache-2.0 + Commons Clause) control layer for a machine's Internet connections: 108 real network tools, tiered network bridges, traffic control, a background service (linkfyrd), and desktop, mobile and CLI clients over one versioned IPC contract. Local-only by default.

## Docs

- [Architecture](https://linkfyr.docs.potenfyr.in/docs/architecture/): process topology, crate map, data flow, budgets
- [Roadmap](https://linkfyr.docs.potenfyr.in/docs/roadmap/): every feature, classified; nothing dropped
- [Platform support](https://linkfyr.docs.potenfyr.in/docs/platform-support/): per-OS capability matrix
- [linkfyrd service](https://linkfyr.docs.potenfyr.in/docs/daemon/): Windows service, systemd, launchd
- [Mobile companion](https://linkfyr.docs.potenfyr.in/docs/mobile/): Tauri 2 app for Android and iOS
- [Threat model](https://linkfyr.docs.potenfyr.in/docs/threat-model/): STRIDE and fail-open/fail-closed policy
- [Security](https://linkfyr.docs.potenfyr.in/docs/security/): IPC hardening, supply chain, signing
- [Releases](https://linkfyr.docs.potenfyr.in/docs/releases/): idempotent release pipeline
